subject: Deployment pathway — quick recap and proposed next steps
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Jindal <a.jindal@staplepay.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Deployment pathway — quick recap and proposed next steps

Hi Aisha,

Great to meet earlier — thanks for walking through StaplePay's tokenization and reconciliation use cases. Quick recap from our side and a proposed next step so we can keep momentum: 

- Current ask: low-latency token generation + embeddings for fraud detection and merchant search.
- Scale signal: pilot ~10M tokens/month, production target ~150M tokens/month in Q4.
- Preference: data residency and network isolation are priorities for security; you mentioned VPC / on-prem interest for regulated workloads.

Quick proposed next steps: 
1) I'll share a short one-pager that maps our Dedicated and Private deployment options to the security and latency constraints you mentioned. (attached)
2) Ben (cc) can run a technical follow-up to cover VPC network segmentation and on-prem feasibility.
3) If this looks right, we can schedule a 30-min technical deep-dive next week with your infra/security folks.

Attachments: StaplePay_MVP_requirements.pdf (pdf) — our notes from the call + initial questionnaire.

A couple of questions to help Ben and Monica prep: 
- Do you have a preferred procurement timeline (approx month/quarter)?
- Who should we loop in on your security side (SOC2/accounting of logs)?

If you prefer, we can also propose a short statement of work for a scoped POC that includes an on-prem pilot option.

Thanks —
Tessa Morgan
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
T: +1 (415) 555-0198
https://www.redwood.inference
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Jindal <a.jindal@staplepay.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Feb 2027 10:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Deployment pathway — quick recap and proposed next steps

Hi Aisha — looping back on this thread. Wanted to check whether StaplePay has had a chance to prioritize the deployment pathway (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private). Even a rough timeline is helpful so we can align capacity and pricing.

If now isn't the right time, a one-line update on priority would be great. Also happy to set up the 30-min tech sync Ben proposed — Mon/Wed next week both open from our side.

Cheers,
Tessa

(on mobile)
From: Aisha Jindal <a.jindal@staplepay.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lee <marcus.lee@staplepay.com>, procurement@staplepay.com
Date: Fri, 26 Feb 2027 14:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Deployment pathway — quick recap and proposed next steps

Hi Tessa — thanks for the follow-up and sorry for the delay. Procurement and security have been heads-down this quarter; appreciate the patience. 

A few notes from our side: 
- Priority: this is a Q3 initiative for product/ops, but procurement won't be able to start the contracting process until late Q2. So timeline is shifted but the project is still green.
- Security asks: Marcus (cc) is our security lead and would like more clarity on network segmentation, ingress/egress controls for VPC, and whether Redwood can support an air-gapped on-prem pilot for sensitive token stores.
- Compliance: we need SOC 2 Type II evidence and a list of audit logs/retention options. Can you share those?

I've attached a high-level network diagram and our security checklist so you can see our constraints.

Attachments: staplepay_network_drawings.pdf (pdf)

If you can give specifics around the Private/on-prem option (deployment footprint, cadence for updates, and pricing ranges) that would help us decide whether to proceed with a Dedicated reservation or an on-prem pilot.

Thanks,
Aisha Jindal
Head of Product Operations | StaplePay
a.jindal@staplepay.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lee <marcus.lee@staplepay.com>, Aisha Jindal <a.jindal@staplepay.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Deployment pathway — quick recap and proposed next steps

Hi Aisha / Marcus — thanks for the context and the diagram. Monica and I dug into the network sketch you shared; a few quick clarifications and a proposal for next steps below.

Clarifications we need to confirm (short answers are fine):
- Where would the token store live in your on-prem architecture (segmented vault vs HSM)?
- Does your infra team have a strict outbound allowlist for updates, or can we negotiate a proxy/update window for an on-prem pilot?

What Redwood can provide now: 
- SOC 2 Type II summary and security whitepaper (I attached a short pack and the scoped evidence checklist).
- Private deployment options: 1) VPC (customer-managed VPC peering + strict ingress rules), 2) On-prem (air-gapped image + scheduled secure sync for telemetry, optional HSM integration).
- Ballpark pricing: I attached an XLS with Dedicated reservation tiers and a one-off on-prem pilot estimate so procurement has numbers to work with.

Proposed next step: 30-min technical deep-dive with your security and infra team next Tue/Wed. Monica will lead the call on our side to walk through network controls and the pilot model. Please share two slots that work for you and Marcus, or let us propose.

Attachments: Redwood-dedicated-pricing.xlsx (xlsx), Redwood_SOC2_summary.pdf (pdf)

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
